claims.text: The two groups of log lines from 123.235.32.19 and 52.80.34.196 exhibit distinct patterns of behavior, with 123.235.32.19 displaying a rapid succession of failed password attempts for the root user within a short time frame, specifically between 07:32:27 and 07:34:33, with 13 failed attempts in just over 2 minutes.

In contrast, 52.80.34.196 shows a more sporadic pattern of activity, with failed password attempts for various invalid users, including test9, test, and matlab, spread out over a longer period of time, from 07:07:38 to 10:21:09.
Notably, 123.235.32.19's attempts are focused solely on the root user, whereas 52.80.34.196's attempts target different usernames.

The repetition of failed password attempts without any apparent corrective action from 123.235.32.19, particularly the concentrated burst of activity, suggests a more anomalous and potentially malicious behavior compared to 52.80.34.196.
The root cause of the anomaly is that these errors from 123.235.32.19 recur rapidly without any corrective action in between, indicating a possible automated attack on the root account.
